description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithJobTitle class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup procedures for fixtures and a test method testing formatted value retrieval based on employee ID.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithJobTitle, verifies correct formatted values based on employee data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading configuration and populating test data, and initializes the FormatWithJobTitle instance.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method returns the expected formatted job title or null for given employee IDs.
